subject: Trading
title: Risk Is Not the Enemy
description: A micro-lesson that makes Risk Is Not the Enemy usable.

hook.text: Without risk there is no return. Every dollar of profit came from someone else's risk taken—including yours.

buildup.text: The risk premium—extra return for bearing uncertainty—is the fundamental reason investing works.

discovery.text: Stocks returned 10% annually over a century precisely because they're risky. Safe assets return less.

twist.text: Avoiding all risk is itself risky—inflation erodes cash at 3% per year. No-risk means guaranteed loss of buying power.

climax.text: The goal isn't zero risk. It's intelligent risk—taking calculated bets where the odds favor you.

punchline.text: Embrace risk. Just do it with open eyes.

quiz.question: Why do stocks offer higher returns than savings accounts?
options: Investors demand a risk premium for bearing uncertainty
